classification.difficultyReason: Locate each fraction relative to the benchmarks and compare distances using equivalent fractions or subtraction; this links routine fraction procedures with interpreting which value is nearest.

content.prompt: Which of the fractions $\frac{1}{4}$, $\frac{1}{2}$, $\frac{5}{8}$ and $1\frac{4}{5}$ is the closest to each of the fractions below?

answer.worked:
The fraction lies between $\frac{5}{8}$ and $1\frac{4}{5}$; the other choices are smaller and farther away.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{4}{6}-\frac{5}{8}&=\frac{16-15}{24}=\frac{1}{24}\\\frac{9}{5}-\frac{4}{6}&=\frac{27-10}{15}=\frac{17}{15}\end{align*}$$
The smaller difference is $\frac{1}{24}$, so $\frac{5}{8}$ is closest.

The fraction lies between $\frac{1}{4}$ and $\frac{1}{2}$; the other choices are larger and farther away.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{4}{12}-\frac{1}{4}&=\frac{4-3}{12}=\frac{1}{12}\\\frac{1}{2}-\frac{4}{12}&=\frac{6-4}{12}=\frac{1}{6}\end{align*}$$
Since $\frac{1}{12}<\frac{1}{6}$, $\frac{1}{4}$ is closest.

The fraction lies between $\frac{1}{4}$ and $\frac{1}{2}$; the other choices are larger and farther away.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{4}{9}-\frac{1}{4}&=\frac{16-9}{36}=\frac{7}{36}\\\frac{1}{2}-\frac{4}{9}&=\frac{9-8}{18}=\frac{1}{18}\end{align*}$$
Since $\frac{1}{18}=\frac{2}{36}<\frac{7}{36}$, $\frac{1}{2}$ is closest.

The fraction lies between $\frac{1}{2}$ and $\frac{5}{8}$; the other choices lie farther outside this interval.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{9}{17}-\frac{1}{2}&=\frac{18-17}{34}=\frac{1}{34}\\\frac{5}{8}-\frac{9}{17}&=\frac{85-72}{136}=\frac{13}{136}\end{align*}$$
Since $\frac{1}{34}=\frac{4}{136}<\frac{13}{136}$, $\frac{1}{2}$ is closest.

The fraction lies between $\frac{1}{4}$ and $\frac{1}{2}$; the other choices are larger and farther away.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{47}{96}-\frac{1}{4}&=\frac{47-24}{96}=\frac{23}{96}\\\frac{1}{2}-\frac{47}{96}&=\frac{48-47}{96}=\frac{1}{96}\end{align*}$$
Since $\frac{1}{96}<\frac{23}{96}$, $\frac{1}{2}$ is closest.

The fraction lies between $\frac{1}{4}$ and $\frac{1}{2}$; the other choices are larger and farther away.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{31}{120}-\frac{1}{4}&=\frac{31-30}{120}=\frac{1}{120}\\\frac{1}{2}-\frac{31}{120}&=\frac{60-31}{120}=\frac{29}{120}\end{align*}$$
Since $\frac{1}{120}<\frac{29}{120}$, $\frac{1}{4}$ is closest.

$\frac{199}{100}$ is greater than all four choices, so the largest choice is closest.

$$\begin{align*}1\frac{4}{5}&=\frac{180}{100}\\\frac{199}{100}-1\frac{4}{5}&=\frac{19}{100}\end{align*}$$
Therefore $1\frac{4}{5}$ is closest.

The fraction lies between $\frac{5}{8}$ and $1\frac{4}{5}$; the other choices are smaller and farther away.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{299}{402}-\frac{5}{8}&=\frac{1196-1005}{1608}=\frac{191}{1608}\\\frac{9}{5}-\frac{299}{402}&=\frac{3618-1495}{2010}=\frac{2123}{2010}\end{align*}$$
The first difference is less than $1$, while the second is greater than $1$. Therefore $\frac{5}{8}$ is closest.
